title: Kenyan Flaxseed Breakfast Bake
description: A hearty breakfast bake with a Kenyan twist, packed with flaxseed for extra nutrition.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the oatmeal, flaxseed, and almonds.
In a separate bowl, mix the coconut oil, maple syrup, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Mash the bananas and add them to the mixture. Stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
